test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 29 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In a code language, COPPER is written as FQTRJT then how will SILVER be written as in that code language?
solution:
The positional value of the alphabets are as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47a827e903e52c199d8cea030f3655db9b02da63af4503920b2e34c4d18d2c5d.png] 

Here, COPPER = FQTRJT

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2a4f78fa25451e8af4aabce1fc3da1a126463c9429d35ca823f837fd91f20a5a.png] 

Similarly, for SILVER = ?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a5dd3907893c115145a08562b0352aeb0c128ebb0004d2f746c628d103e5cd51.png] 

**SILVER **will be written as** VKPXJT**

Hence, the correct answer is** option(2)**
